verdict.rationale: Aircall is a cloud phone SaaS, so it is not run as a binary in CI. It does document a Public API with Basic Authentication that lets scripts drive core operations without the UI: starting outbound calls, controlling recording, launching campaigns and triggering SMS. That supports headless automation, but nothing documents a CLI, CI-specific usage or service-account patterns. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless client, CI/CD integration docs, service-account or token guidance for unattended pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Detailed step-by-step guide to interact with the Aircall Public API using Basic Authentication.
